G6.2.title: F5 every cell non-NaN; trained-RL mean_reward strictly exceeds recommended-action (D6.2.1 revised)
G6.2.finding_summary: Phase-5 val-split numbers (~25× over baseline) did NOT generalise to test_balanced; recommended-action rule baseline strictly dominates trained RL on the held-out split. Headline finding of Phase 6, deferred to Phase 7 reward-component ablation.

G6.3.title: F6 per-algo proportionality band on non-IMPACT stages ≥ 0.70
G6.3.notes: All three trained RL agents learn proportional behaviour on the four non-IMPACT stages. The IMPACT row's de-escalation farming (G5.4 finding) is excluded by D6.7 and visualised on F6 as the Phase-7 hand-off.

G6.4.title: F7 inference latency p50 within budget per policy class
G6.4.threshold: RL ≤ 5 ms / RF ≤ 3 ms / rule ≤ 1 ms
G6.4.finding_summary: 7 of 8 policies pass with ≥ 30× headroom. RF-Acting alone exceeds the 3 ms RF budget (~4.7× over) due to sklearn per-call dispatch over a 100-tree ensemble; production deployments would batch / compile (treelite/skl2onnx) and easily meet the budget. Headline RL latency claim unaffected.

G6.5.title: F8 trained-RL CI does not overlap any non-RL baseline CI
G6.5.notes: All three RL bars are statistically separated from every non-RL baseline. Rule floor (+1624) sits clearly above the RL cluster (+1297..+1336); always-X / random sit clearly below. Direction of separation is no longer required by G6.5 per D6.2.1; the gate validates the cluster structure.

G6.6.title: No regression on Phase-3 / 4 / 5 frozen tests
G6.6.threshold: test_phase3_env_gates, test_adversarial_env, test_blue_team_*, test_detector all green

G6.7.title: Reproducibility — every figure ships a manifest with SHA-256 input hashes + git SHA
G6.7.threshold: F5_manifest, F6_manifest, F7_manifest, F8_manifest all populated

summary.headline_finding: On the held-out test_balanced split, the IoTWarden recommended-action rule baseline (+1624) strictly dominates the trained RL trio (DQN +1336 / PPO +1313 / A2C +1297). Phase-5's "25x over baseline" claim was a val-split selection-bias artefact; the trained agents converged on a de-escalation-farming strategy (G5.4) that does not generalise. Phase 7's reward-component ablation owns the remediation.
summary.secondary_finding: RF-Acting baseline (+1508) is closer to the rule floor than to the RL cluster, validating the supervised-stage-classifier-plus-rules construction as a strong baseline. Its 14 ms inference latency exceeds the 3 ms budget but is a property of sklearn per-call dispatch on a 100-tree ensemble, not of the RandomForest detector head itself.
